name: run the monitor over the required total duration at the correct sampling interval
definition: Let the sampling loop run ~60 seconds with samples spaced ~10 seconds apart so the log spans the expected window.
failure_mode: Loop stops early or sleeps wrong amount, so time-span/interval checks fail.

name: translate rstan sampling hyperparameters to pystan semantics
definition: Map the R sampling configuration (chain counts, sampling+adaptation iteration totals, sampler control arguments) to PyStan's corresponding settings so the effective draws/warmup match the references.
failure_mode: Warmup vs sample misallocation (num_warmup vs iter semantics) returns under-converged means.
